subject.title: fix(github-copilot): preserve thinking levels for Claude models

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live OpenClaw proof of `/thinking high` on a GitHub Copilot Claude model, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The contributor says live Copilot proof requires credentials they do not have, and automation cannot validate the account-bound provider path from unit tests alone.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording from a contributor or maintainer showing the real Copilot Claude `/thinking high` path before merge.

options.title: Use maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer with Copilot credentials can explicitly accept the source/test evidence and own the remaining provider-boundary risk.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording from a contributor or maintainer showing the real Copilot Claude `/thinking high` path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently handled the overlapping Copilot thinking PR and supplied maintainer closeout context pointing to this PR as the preferred path.
